text:
claire: kicking off a micro-canary window for model-routing-v3 now. goal: progressive ramp with a conservative soft-eject policy so we can catch regressions early. need checklist: exact thresholds, who pages on escalation, quick rollback commands. whos oncall? :eyes:

deploy-bot: release window queued for feature_flag=model_route_v3. start command: `/deploy start --ff model_route_v3 --ramp 5,30,100 --slo-errors 2% --notes "micro-canary progressive ramp"`

miguel: suggested policy: start at 5%. trigger soft-eject if agent.api.5xx_rate > 0.6% over a 3m window. if that condition stays true for 8m escalate to full pin to v1 (100%). after stable 4m we auto-drain to 15% to keep capacity headroom. suppression: dont re-ramp for at least 6m after a soft-eject.

harry: +1 for conservative approach. note that any session-affecting endpoints should be pinned immediately to avoid session shards. soft-eject ok for stateless inference.

oncall_bot: paging policy: page on sustained 5xx > 0.9% for 5m. notify #incidents and oncall pager. alert also to #eng-oncall for visibility at 0.6% over 3m but only as chat alert (no page).

claire: adding brief release note: "model-routing-v3: micro-canary progressive rollout with automatic soft-ejects and v1 fallback on sustained regression." linking runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/model-route-v3-rollout

miguel: runbook config snippet for ops (paste into runbook):
```yaml
feature_flag: model_route_v3
ramp_steps: [5, 30, 100]
eject:
  soft_threshold_pct: 0.6%    # 5xx rate over short window
  soft_window: 3m
  escalate_window: 8m        # sustain to escalate to full pin
  fallback_version: v1
  fallback_percent: 100
  cooldown_after_soft: 6m
  auto_drain_after_stable: 15%
monitoring:
  error_metric: agent.api.5xx_rate
  latency_p95_ms: 180
  alerting:
    chat_channels: ["#incidents"]
    page_threshold: 0.9% # sustained 5m
notes: |
  For session-affecting routes consider immediate full pin.
  Document soft-eject events in rollout history for postmortem.
```

deploy-bot: Deploy initiated. Canary at 5% started (canary_ts=1725550100). Monitor with `/metrics query agent.api.5xx_rate --window 3m --ff model_route_v3` and `/metrics query agent.api.p95 --window 3m --ff model_route_v3`. Bot will post updates and annotations.

harry: Im on infra watch. hold ramp if p95 > 180ms or if 5xx spikes above 0.6% in the 3m window.

oncall_bot: reminder: avoid automatic noisy flips. alerts suppressed for 4m after a soft-eject event to allow for stabilization.

miguel: manual pin command if needed: `/ff pin model_route_v3 --to v1 --percent 100 --reason "escalation after sustained 5xx"` -- this updates routing and rollout state.

claire: confirmed preflight checks green. adding post-launch checklist entry: capture any soft-eject reasons and include annotated graphs in postmortem. tagging @harry @miguel for final signoff. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Canary completed: no page events and no sustained alerts in the 3m window. scheduling ramp to 30% in 8m (next_ramp_ts=1725550900). Annotations will appear in `/rollout history model_route_v3`.

harry: infra stable from my side. proceed with 30% when bot triggers.

claire: proceeding. remind everyone: if soft-eject triggers, please paste the `/rollout history` entry here and include any immediate mitigations taken.

deploy-bot: Update: 30% ramp started (ramp_ts=1725550900). Ill post a final summary after the 100% step or any rollback.

miguel: agreed plan: if escalation -> pin -> customer comms -> postmortem. leaving a 30m watch after final ramp.

claire: thanks all  keeping this thread as the canonical rollout log. :rocket:
